scope: Both ECC facade and original tests read whole; pinned Git blob verified. Static review only; ECC dependencies not installed or executed.

findings.detail: Algorithms 3 and 4 call module-global reedsolo.init_tables with different field polynomials. Instances retain generator polynomials but do not restore field tables before encode/decode/check. Interleaved differently configured instances therefore require qualification. Source-level hazard, not executed corruption proof.

Parameter detector imports reedsolo under another local name with a comment expecting isolated tables. Ordinary imports share the same module object; aliasing does not isolate global field state. If ECC facade uses pure Python reedsolo, detector table reinitialization shares it.

Detector searches gen_nb and c_exp but calls init_tables(prim) without forwarding generator/c_exp and rs_encode_msg without forwarding gen_nb. Its reported search parameters need direct round-trip verification.

compute_ecc_params accepts negative/nonfinite rate and arbitrary max_block_size without explicit bounds; rate=-0.5 divides by zero. ECCMan relies partly on backend validation. No work/cancellation budget for exhaustive parameter search.
ECCMan.check checks codeword consistency against selected codec, not equality to an independently trusted original. Valid codeword or successful correction is not proof of file identity.

Six original methods cover parameter search, nominal size/rate vectors, four codec variants, padding and decoding. Codec tests instantiate/use each variant sequentially, not interleave active instances. Last two decode tests assert tuple truthiness rather than exact recovered bytes; incorrect nonempty tuples could pass.
